method: scripts/bench-engine.py: 10 fresh processes, spawn to first hello response; size of the one-dir folder or the one-file binary; peak RSS of the process tree (ru_maxrss). Release asset = one-dir folder packed as .tar.gz/.zip.
decision: one-dir. One-file is 9.6 MB but unpacks itself on every start: about 4 s on macOS arm64, far over the 1 s target. One-dir starts in about 0.13 s and is 33.8 MB unpacked (under 40 MB), 9.5 MB as the release archive. Nuitka was not measured: PyInstaller one-dir already meets every target on the platform that could be measured locally.
ci: per-platform numbers of the five native runners are uploaded as bench/<platform>-<mode>.json inside each engine-<platform> artifact of the Engine binaries workflow; see the pull request for the run that recorded them
